items.key: Four draft languages: reading choices, map reviews and report version details.
items.draft: Iilwimi ezine eziyidrafti: ukhetho lokufunda, uphononongo lweemephu neenkcukacha zenguqulelo yengxelo.
items.backtranslation: Four draft languages: study choice, map review and report-translation details.
items.problem: 'report version details' rendered 'iinkcukacha zenguqulelo yengxelo', which a reader takes as 'report translation details' (inguqulelo = translation in this same app copy). The note is about report versions; use uhlelo (version/edition).
items.corrected: Iilwimi ezine eziyidrafti: ukhetho lokufunda, uphononongo lweemephu neenkcukacha zohlelo lwengxelo.

items.key: Sesotho, Xitsonga and Tshivenda: more site report, map and Lima controls.
items.draft: IsiSuthu, isiTsonga nesiTshivenda: izilawuli ezininzi zengxelo yendawo, zemephu nezikaLima.
items.backtranslation: Sesotho, Xitsonga and Tshivenda: many site-report, map and Lima controls.
items.problem: 'more ... controls' (additional ones now translated) became 'izilawuli ezininzi' = 'many controls', overstating coverage and losing the 'in addition' sense.
items.corrected: IsiSuthu, isiTsonga nesiTshivenda: izilawuli ezingakumbi zengxelo yendawo, zemephu nezikaLima.

items.key: Sesotho, Xitsonga and Tshivenda: more menus, site progress and sign-in messages.
items.draft: IsiSuthu, isiTsonga nesiTshivenda: iimenyu ezininzi, inkqubela yendawo nemiyalezo yokungena.
items.backtranslation: Sesotho, Xitsonga and Tshivenda: many menus, site progress and sign-in messages.
items.problem: 'more menus' became 'iimenyu ezininzi' = 'many menus'; same drift as entry 38.
items.corrected: IsiSuthu, isiTsonga nesiTshivenda: iimenyu ezingakumbi, inkqubela yendawo nemiyalezo yokungena.

items.key: Saving offline keeps your note or message instead of losing it or hanging.
items.draft: Ukugcina ngaphandle kwe-intanethi kugcina inqaku lakho okanye umyalezo endaweni yokuwulahla okanye ukuthi i-app ibambeke.
items.backtranslation: Offline saving keeps your note or message instead of throwing it away or saying the app is stuck.
items.problem: 'instead of losing it or hanging' — 'okanye ukuthi i-app ibambeke' reads as 'or saying that the app is stuck' (ukuthi = to say). The English means the app no longer hangs.
items.corrected: Ukugcina ngaphandle kwe-intanethi kugcina inqaku lakho okanye umyalezo endaweni yokuwulahla okanye yokuba i-app ibambeke.

items.key: On a laptop each page has one set of links at the top, and titles are no longer cut off.
items.draft: Kwilaptop, iphepha ngalinye linamakhonkco amanye kuphela phezulu, kwaye izihloko azisanqunyulwa.
items.backtranslation: On a laptop, each page has only some/other links at the top, and headings are no longer cut off.
items.problem: 'one set of links' rendered 'amakhonkco amanye kuphela', which reads as 'only some/other links' rather than a single set of links.
items.corrected: Kwilaptop, iphepha ngalinye lineqela elinye kuphela lamakhonkco phezulu, kwaye izihloko azisanqunyulwa.

items.key: Prepared examples are labelled clearly; unused report settings are hidden.
items.draft: Imizekelo elungisiweyo iphawulwe ngokucacileyo; iisetingi zengxelo ezingasetyenziswayo zifihliwe.
items.backtranslation: Corrected samples are clearly marked; unused report settings are hidden.
items.problem: 'Prepared examples' rendered 'Imizekelo elungisiweyo', which in this same file means 'corrected' (entry 71 'amakhadi alungisiweyo' = corrected cards). A reader thinks the examples were fixed. Use -lungiselelwe (prepared).
items.corrected: Imizekelo elungiselelweyo iphawulwe ngokucacileyo; iisetingi zengxelo ezingasetyenziswayo zifihliwe.
